lines: 「You tellin' me there's some cow bitch acting up in my cell?」
Right in front of me, after I had driven back the female prisoners, the boss of Cell H finally showed hersel――― Wait a minute!
「I gotta discipline this cocky cow bitch, don't I?!」
「Huh? Don'tcha know me, ya dimwit cow bitch? Listen up and listen well. I'm the Queen of Destruction, Yukikaze!」
「H-Hey you, Bull Demon Queen! Yer done for now!」
「We're finally gonna get to see the Taimanin's ultimate weapon, the lightning attack of that walking powder keg, Yukikaze-sama!」
「This'll be the first time for us too!」
「If you're gonna apologize, now's the time, Cowtits!!!」
I didn't even want to know what kind of smooth talk she had tricked them with, but
「.........They've completely fallen for her bluff, haven't they?」
「Hey, hey! Ya ever hear the stories about Yukikaze-sama?!」
「Heh? Nnaaaaahhhh?! H-How do you know m—I mean, that name?!」
「Wh-What?! Hey! Hey, you! What're you doing with the Destruction Queen Yukikaze?」
I pulled the boss, Destruction Queen Yukikaze—that good-for-nothing succubus, Lilim—towards the back of Cell H.
「Oi, how did you get away from Metier? And to think you'd be in a place like this after all that.」
「Last time, Yukikaze destroyed that weird mecha in one blow, so I can understand you wanting to take her name.」
「Hey, h-how'd you know that much? Who the hell are you? Don't tell me you're my stalker?」
「Who's a stalker? You can't tell in this form, huh? It's me.」
「M-Me? Is this like one of those “Hi, it's me” phone scams?」
I covered her mouth with my hand.
「How? How do you look like that? Fuuma, don't tell me you were so unpopular with women that you became a woman yourself?? Ew, gross!」
「Huh? Th-Then, why'd you become a woman and end up in prison?! I know! This is your perverted fetish, right?!!!」
「Like I'm gonna become a convict on account of some perverted fetish!!!」
「What's the sex offender saying, at this point?!」
Shit, this conversation wasn't going anywhere. I suddenly wrapped my arm around Lilim's head.
「Uggggh, th-that hurts! Ewww, your boobs are touching me! Perverted Fuuma's boobs are real! Mega-gross!」
「Shut up and listen. I'm on a mission right now. I don't want to start any trouble. Are you gonna cooperate with me here?」
A deeply reluctant-sounding voice came back to me.
「Then it's okay for me to reveal that you're not Yukikaze?」
「......So, we'll forget about our old grudges and do a strategic alliance kinda thing, right?
All of a sudden, she had completely changed her tune.
And so it had come to pass that I would form a hasty partnership with Lilim.
「All o' you, listen up! This woman's a buddy of mine!」
I smacked the head of the idiot who was about to say my name out of nowhere.
「What are you doing, giving away my true identity? Right now I'm “Onisaki Kirara”.」
「I get it, shut up! Uhh, this is Onisaki Kirara!」
「You guys've heard the name of Kirara, the “Hybrid Taimanin” before, right?! That's her! My pal! My bosom buddy!」
Lilim introduced me, with an air of desperation.
「S-Seriously?! Isn't that the oni-like Taimanin who'll turn you into an ice carving just for making eye contact?!」
「The ice oni who can't help but freeze anyone she doesn't like, and then smash them to pieces?!」
「I heard she's got a major hate for mages, and she turns all the mages she defeats into shaved ice and eats their magic power!」
It seemed like some ridiculous things were said about Kirara-senpai.
It would appear that her name thundered through underworld circles, not as a half-oni, but as a Taimanin whose behaviour was like an oni.
It would be a pain to correct them, so I let it pass here.
「That's right! Me and Kirara here are bosom buddies!」
「Now you'll be even stronger, eh, Boss?!!」
「The day is near when the Boss is gonna take control of all the cells, and become the Big Boss of Amidahara Prison!!」
「That's right, that's right!! Everyone stick with me!! Aaaaaha ha ha ha!!」
That good-for-nothing Lilim was getting carried away.
「K-Kirara-san, were you going easy on us lowdown, insolent guys before?」
The strongest woman from earlier timidly addressed me.
「Uh, yeah...... Well, something like that. We're going to be living in the same cell from here on, after all. Is your stomach all right?」
「M-My stomach is nothing...... It's not just your chest that's big, but your heart, too. Thank you very much, Kirara-san.」
「That's a friend of the Boss for you. Nice to meet you, Kirara-san.」
Every one of the female prisoners, including the ones I had just defeated, were bowing their heads in admiration.
It was kind of a strange development, but as far as results went, it was convenient, huh?
「Oi, Lil―――I mean, Yukikaze. There's something I want to ask you.」
「Well, I'm looking for a Taimanin who came here a short time ago, named Shikanosuke.」
「There's no one like that here in Cell H, right? Any idea where to look?」
「Shikanosuke? That's a man's name. D-Don't tell me he's a pervert with a feminization fetish too?」
「Who's a pervert with a feminization fetish?! I told you this is a mission!」
And so, guided by Lilim, I had come to the canteen that the prisoners in every cell used.
「C'mon, c'mon, outta the way. Destruction Queen Yukikaze-sama is coming through!」
With one of the prisoners taking the vanguard, Lilim paraded through the canteen with me.
The female convicts, who were all tricky customers, made way for us with looks of fright, flattery, hostility, and many other things besides.
According to what I had heard, all the cells were engaged in a power struggle over numbers and location in the canteen.
And Cell H appeared to boast the largest territory, as a result of Yukikaze's notoriety.
「You're making a pretty haughty face, aren't you?」
「Ha ha ha, for sure. How about it? Impressed?」
It didn't change the fact that she was just a little critter, but Lilim appeared to be someone who really knew how to survive in the Demon World.
I wasn't impressed at all, though.
「She's here. That's the Bull Demon Queen!」
「I hear she's a pretty dangerous one. If you make eye contact, you'll get frozen!」
I could hear whispered conversations from all around for some reason.
「Don't be in such a rush. Let's see, if I'm not mistaken...... Ah, there he is!」
When I looked in the direction Lilim pointed, Shikanosuke was serving food next to a big pot, with a ladle in one hand.
「No! There's a set amount for one person.」
How had he acclimatized this much?
Thinking “Dear, dear,” I was about to line up too, when the prisoners in front suddenly made way for me.
「Hey! What happened to the next one?」
「You'll pile it on for me, right?」
「I told you, there's a set amount for―――」
Shikanosuke goggled his eyes at me in surprise, but soon made his face brighten up.
「D-Don't tell me Kirara-senpai came all the way here to save me?! Wow, awesome! Thank you very much, Kirara-senpai!」
I couldn't afford to verbalize anything beyond that point here.
I used the hand signals I employed when I directed our tactics to quickly communicate that I was me, and that my appearance had changed because of Kirara-senpai's Ninja Arts.
As soon as I did, Shikanosuke looked disappointed.
「Ah, is that so? I see...... Haah...」
「Don't you sigh at me. I went to all the trouble of coming here, you know?」
「Anyway, why are you being treated like a female prisoner?」
「Somehow, looks like you've gotten really used to it, though. Ah, I'll have a big serving, yeah?」
「I told you, the amount is set!」
He sloppily dished out my portion of the stew.
After that, I pulled Shikanosuke over to a table, and listened to his story as I poked at the suspicious-looking meat.
Their names were Yuffie and Sophie.
They were humanoid weapons created using technology from Hell and the UFS.
However, they had escaped from the UFS in pursuit of freedom.
It was a story I was hearing often, all of a sudden. It was just like the time with Saya NEO.
The developments which followed that had been a similar sort of thing as well, with various powers who knew about the oni twins starting to pursue them.
And sure enough, at the request of the Masked Taimanin, a Taimanin force, including Shikanosuke among others, had made contact with them.
They had negotiated to shelter the twins, asking if they would allow Gosha to safeguard them.
The oni twins had, surprisingly, agreed, saying 「Sounds fun.」
But in the course of travelling to Gosha, they were surprise-attacked by a giant cyborg, and their unit was scattered―――
「And when I came to, I'd been imprisoned here.」
「You skipped over the end. After you were scattered, how did you get captured?」
「Th-That doesn't really matter, does it?! Anyway, I got caught. I messed up. Don't ask me the little details!」
Shikanosuke snapped back at me defensively.
Well, I guess he didn't want to explain his own mistake in detail.
「All right, fine. That huge cyborg...... Was it the one who made that surprise attack against Headmistress Asagi?」
If that were the case, then was the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office involved in this matter?
「Hey, hey, more importantly, how're we gonna break out?!」
Shikanosuke said, as if to hurry me.
Lilim was in agreement with that.
「Weren't you planning on living a life of luxury here as Yukikaze?」
「I was gonna, but then somehow you appeared again.」
「Anyway, it's probably gonna get screwed up again, so I'm thinking I'm gonna scram, ASAP. With the Chief, if possible. Nihihihihi!」
「But that's the right call, isn't it? Let get outta this place quickly!」
「I've planned for that, but not until I've accomplished my mission.」
「Mission?! Didn't you come to rescue me?!」
「Of course I did. But those oni twins you mentioned are here too, right? Here in Amidahara Prison.」
「Well, I think they're here, but, like... Are we gonna bring those two back with us?」
「Naturally. Protect you and those two, and take you back to Gosha. That's my mission.」
Shikanosuke fell flat on his face despondently.
Lilim also grumbled, in the same pose. These guys were like two peas in a pod. Had they gotten used to each other because they lived in the same prison?
I showed them the toothbrush that was my sole possession.
「Naughty toy, that you use to play with yourself night after night in that body! Uh-oh! We got a real, genuine perv!」
I retorted for starters, and then told the two idiots,
「This is a special GPS device, and it's the secret item that'll help us.」
Meanwhile, belowground, Sakura had given the demon dog brigade the slip, and arrived at the cell she was aiming for.
「Even if they are demon dogs, I can't just cut down puppies, after all.」
「And in here, there are two cute girls with horns. Yuffie and Sophie, right? Fouuund you♪」
Before her eyes were the oni twins Yuffie and Sophie, who were her extraction targets.
They were making innocent smiles, without any sign that they were afraid of being in this underground prison full of demon dogs (which went for Sakura as well, though).
「We have been found, haven't we? But, that person appeared out of that shadow all of a sudden.」
「Uh-huh, uh-huh, she slid out of it. Could she be a bad guy, I wonder?」
「She might be. Maybe she's a Revenant Knight who's come to kill us.」
The twin oni were playing together like they weren't scared in the slightest.
「Hey, hey, who are you calling a Revenant Night? I'm a friend of Shikanosuke-kun, and I've come to help you.」
「Then, could it be that you're a prince?」
「It's always a prince who saves the princess, isn't it? Right?」
Perhaps because they were acting out being kidnapped princesses, the twins were treating Sakura like a prince all of a sudden, and she made her shoulders slump.
「Haaah～～～, a prince, huh? I wish a prince would appear for me, too. I wonder if there is a prince anywhere out there...」
「Eh? Onee-chan? You don't have a prince of your own, then? Sad.」
「Hey, Sophie, you mustn't say things like that. Excuse my little sister. Come on, apologize!」
「Ah, I shouldn't have said that. Sorry, Onee-chan.」
「Boo-hoo～～, now I'm being apologized to. That hurts...」
Sakura was feeling low, but she forced herself to get back up.
「Well, still, if there's no prince, then there's a way I can be the prince myself, right? Yeah, that's it, that's it.」
「Hey, there! Don't have doubts! Onee-chan's gonna cry!」
「Maybe she's a bad guy after all?」
「Ah, I mean...... Ahem. I am Prince Igawa Sakura. I've come to save the twin princesses.」
「For real, for real! You two don't want to be in this lonely place anymore, right?」
「Then let's get out of here straight away.」
「It's no use, Yuffie, Sophie. To break out of jail, you gotta defeat the evil witch. That's the deal, y'know?」
What appeared was the warden, Kaura.
「I thought we had an intruder here outside of the agreement, but I never thought they'd be after the twins.」
「Sakura Onee-chan! It's the enemy, the enemy! It's the evil witch!」
「Ahaha. You two are really into this, aren't you?」
It was like they really were playing.
And then, like always, Sakura also drew her swords in an extremely casual manner.
「Don't stray far from Sakura Onee-chan, okay, you two?」
「Also, hold on to these for a little bit. And―――」
Sakura handed some objects over to the two of them, and whispered into their ears.
